svg.aria-label: Fine-tuning RAPiDock for peptides of 13 or more residues: the learning-rate schedule, the three unfreezing phases, the training set and the raw 77-complex long-peptide benchmark.
svg.text: Settings: learning rate 1e-5 · warm-up 2 epochs · batch 8 graphs × gradient accumulation 2
gradient clipping 1.0 · moving average of weights 0.999 · weight decay 1e-5 · 20 epochs
curve drawn from the settings (linear warm-up, cosine decay to the floor)
Phase 2: adds the four cross-graph convolutions
The cross convolutions hold the receptor-interaction capacity that long peptides need.
peptides of 13 or more residues, the main failure of the original model
Contact-type embedding added to the cross edges
(4 learned vectors of 48 numbers, one per type)
the type with the shortest distance is added to each edge
Raw long-peptide benchmark: 77 complexes, 24 samples each, best-of-24 RMSD
